# Synthetic Recovery Benchmark

Phase P2 / TASK 1 + TASK 3. Reproducible synthetic parameter-recovery
benchmark for the electrode active-material volume fractions on the
DFN/Chen2020 (LG M50) demonstrator, using PyBOP 26.10 for estimation.

**Scientific scope:** this is a method/software check — data are generated by
the same model that is fitted. It is *not* experimental validation and does
*not* prove identifiability (scientific rules 7–8). Identifiability is
quantified separately in `docs/IDENTIFIABILITY_STUDY.md`.

## 1. Environment and reproduction

Tested configuration (see `docs/DEPENDENCY_COMPATIBILITY.md`):

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| Python | 3.12.16 |
| pybamm | 26.8.0.0 (pinned) |
| pybop | 26.10 |
| numpy / scipy | 2.x / 1.18.x (see `requirements-integration.lock`) |

From a clean checkout:

```bash
python3.12 -m venv .venv-ecosystem312
.venv-ecosystem312/bin/pip install -r requirements-integration.lock
.venv-ecosystem312/bin/pip install -e .

# single-condition (TASK 1)
.venv-ecosystem312/bin/python benchmarks/parameter_recovery/run_recovery_benchmark.py \
    --config configs/p2/recovery_single_1C.yaml --out results/p2

# multi-condition (TASK 3)
.venv-ecosystem312/bin/python benchmarks/parameter_recovery/run_recovery_benchmark.py \
    --config configs/p2/recovery_multi_0p5_1_2C.yaml --out results/p2
```

Outputs per run: `results/p2/<run_id>/report.json` (all numbers below),
`summary.md`, `recovery_estimates.png`, `cost_convergence.png`.
Software correctness tests: `tests/unit/test_calibration_*.py`
(run with `pytest tests/unit`; PyBOP-dependent tests auto-skip without pybop).

## 2. Recorded configuration (TASK 1 requirements)

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Model | `pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN()` (default options) | config |
| Parameter set | Chen2020 (LG M50), 93 parameters | config |
| Ground truth | neg. volume fraction **0.75**, pos. volume fraction **0.665** | Chen2020 values (unchanged) |
| Initial guesses | [0.62, 0.55]; [0.85, 0.60]; [0.70, 0.75] (multi-start) | `configs/p2/recovery_single_1C.yaml` |
| Parameter bounds | neg: [0.55, 0.90]; pos: [0.45, 0.80] | config |
| Observations | synthetic voltage, `Discharge at 1C for 900 s` (79 points) | config |
| Noise | additive, σ = 2 mV on voltage (`pybop.add_noise`) | config |
| Random seed | 20261104 (numpy RNG; recorded in report) | config |
| Cost function | `pybop.SumSquaredError` on `Voltage [V]` | config |
| Optimiser | `pybop.SciPyMinimize`, L-BFGS-B, `jac=True` (PyBaMM sensitivities), maxiter=100 | config |
| Solver | `pybamm.IDAKLUSolver(rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6)` (fixed-duration protocol: PyBOP removes voltage events) | code |
| Reported | estimates per start, abs/rel recovery error, final cost, runtime, n_evaluations, cost convergence | `report.json` |

## 3. TASK 1 results — single condition (1C, 900 s)

All three initial guesses converge to the **same** optimum:

| Start | neg. estimate | abs err | pos. estimate | abs err | final cost | runtime | evals |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [0.62, 0.55] | 0.74116 | 0.00884 | 0.66939 | 0.00439 | 2.403e-4 | 1.1 s | 14 |
| [0.85, 0.60] | 0.74116 | 0.00884 | 0.66939 | 0.00439 | 2.403e-4 | 1.2 s | 13 |
| [0.70, 0.75] | 0.74116 | 0.00884 | 0.66939 | 0.00439 | 2.403e-4 | 1.1 s | 12 |

- Recovery error: neg **1.18 %** relative (truth 0.75), pos **0.66 %** relative
  (truth 0.665).
- Start-to-start agreement is exact to 5 decimal places: the local landscape
  of this 2-parameter problem is well-behaved (single minimum found from all
  starts within bounds).
- Runtime is ~1.2 s per fit on CPU (IDAKLU + CasADi sensitivities).

## 4. TASK 3 results — multi-condition (0.5C 1800 s + 1C 900 s + 2C 450 s)

Each window spans ≈ 25 % of nominal capacity. Same truth, bounds, noise,
seed and optimiser; data: 68 + 79 + 92 points; `MetaProblem` sums the three
per-condition `SumSquaredError` costs.

| Start | neg. estimate | abs err | pos. estimate | abs err | final cost | runtime |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all three | 0.74211 | 0.00789 | 0.66828 | 0.00328 | 7.358e-4 | 3.3–3.5 s |

### Single vs multi comparison

| Metric | 1C only | 0.5C+1C+2C |
|---|---|---|
| neg. abs error | 0.00884 (1.18 %) | 0.00789 (1.05 %) |
| pos. abs error | 0.00439 (0.66 %) | 0.00328 (0.49 %) |
| start sensitivity | none | none |
| runtime | ~1.2 s | ~3.4 s |

**Interpretation (honest):** multi-condition fitting improves recovery only
modestly for this parameter pair at this noise level (~10–25 % error
reduction). The larger multi-condition benefit appears in *constraint
quality* — the weakest sensitivity direction is strengthened (see
`docs/IDENTIFIABILITY_STUDY.md`: smallest singular value 0.36 → 0.59) and
PyBOP's Hessian classifier stops warning about parameter correlation —
not in the raw point error at σ = 2 mV.

## 5. Limitations

1. Same-model generation: errors here reflect noise and window choice only,
   not model-form error or parameter-set bias.
2. One noise level (σ = 2 mV), one seed; no noise sweep was performed.
3. Fixed-duration 900 s/1800 s/450 s windows (≈ 25 % SOC each), not full
   discharges; larger windows would tighten recovery further.
4. The ground truth equals the Chen2020 values; perturbed ground truths were
   not tested.
5. `SciPyMinimizeOptions` emits a harmless SciPy warning about the legacy
   `disp` option (pybop 26.10 internal).
6. L-BFGS-B gradients come from PyBaMM forward sensitivities — recovery
   quality does not transfer automatically to experimental data (rule 8).
